# Synthetic audit fixture: labeled hostnames (SPEC §27; review thread
# 3888208297) — the label alternation covers `hostname`, `host_name`,
# `HostName`, `HOSTNAME`, `host.name` and the Windows-UI `Computer Name` /
# `ComputerName` spellings. The value anchor is a single identifier run
# of ANY length (letters, digits, hyphens, dots — FQDNs included; one-char
# computer names like PC1 are real — round 29 removed the 4-plus floor);
# spaces break the run, which is the prose brake. Doc filler (localhost, hostname, computer,
# name, your, example.com, example.invalid, test) is excluded by a
# post-match generic gate. Synthetic values.
Windows hostname: ALICE-PC
hostname = "build-runner-01"
Computer Name: DESKTOP-PC1
Machine Name: ALICE-PC
"hostname": "ci-host.example.internal"
host_name := ALICE-PC
HOSTNAME=build-runner-01
hostname: PC1
hostname: abc
hostname: v
# Filler, placeholder and sub-floor forms that must stay silent.
hostname: localhost
hostname: hostname
hostname: computer

computer name: your
hostname = "example.com"
